name: History and Global Humanities Joint Major
faculty: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences

requirements.title: Students complete 120 units, as specified below
Students complete 18 units of 100 and 200 division history courses
Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students must complete at least six lower division history units before enrolling in 300 division work and nine lower division history units before enrolling in 400 division work.

requirements.title: One of HUM 102W, HUM 105, HUM 106 and 4 more
Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Three further lower division global humanities courses, including at least one 200-level course.

sections.title: History Upper Division Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students complete 24 units of 300 and 400 level history courses, of which 12 must be in 400 level.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students must complete at least one course from each group shown below.

sections.note:
Global/Comparative courses that are also included in another group may only be counted towards fulfilling the upper division course requirements for one group.
Group 4 - Global/Comparative
Group 1 - Africa, Asia, Middle East
Group 2 - The Americas
Group 3 - Europe
Students in history joint major programs have the option of taking concentrations to enhance their programs.
Concentration in Middle Eastern and Islamic History
Concentration in British History and Irish History
Concentration in Early Modern World History

sections.title: Global Humanities Upper Division Requirements

requirements.title: 20 units from HUM 302W, HUM 303, HUM 305 and 2 more
requirements.note: Students complete 20 units in upper division global humanities courses.

sections.note:
The following courses are recommended.
Students in the global humanities joint major programs have the option of taking concentrations to enhance their programs.
Concentration in Public Engagement and Intellectual Culture
Concentration in Art and Material Culture
Concentration in Hellenic Studies
Concentration in Mythologies

sections.title: Elective Courses
sections.note: In addition to the courses listed above, students should consult an academic advisor to plan the remaining required elective courses.

grades.label: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences Degree Requirements
grades.text: For all bachelor of arts (BA) programs, students complete 120 units, which includes at least 60 units that must be completed at Simon Fraser University at least 45 upper division units, of which at least 30 upper division units must be completed at Simon Fraser University at least 60 units (including 21 upper division units) in Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences courses satisfaction of the writing, quantitative, and breadth requirements an overall cumulative grade point average (CGPA) and upper division overall CGPA of at least 2.0, and program CGPA and upper division program CGPA of at least 2.0 on the course work used to satisfy the minimum program requirements.

grades.label: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences Degree Requirements
grades.text: FASS departments may define additional GPA requirements for their respective programs.
